test_case_selection: shortest, median-length, and longest complete case among cases no longer than 256 characters; if that prompt exceeds 512 tokenizer tokens, use the three shortest bounded cases; fixed before training; the same cases are visible and executable
policy: fixed 80/20 MBJP-matched interpolation split; proportional strata by return category and complex signature; deterministic score is description TF-IDF cosine minus 0.003 times distance from the frozen MBJP median solution length (27 words); the nearest distinct training description is protected from test
